Find answers to common questions about selling your house fast, as-is, or during a difficult situation. This section helps you understand exactly how we work.
How fast can I get an offer?

Most homeowners receive a cash offer within a few days of reaching out — sometimes faster. Once we have your property details, Paulson personally reviews everything and gets back to you with a straightforward number, no waiting weeks for a bank or buyer’s financing.
Do I need to make repairs before selling?
No. We buy houses exactly as they are — damaged, outdated, vacant, or in any condition. You won’t spend a dollar on repairs, cleaning, or staging before we make an offer.
Is there any obligation once I request an offer?
None at all. Requesting a cash offer is completely free and comes with zero obligation to sell. You can review the offer, ask questions, and decide what’s best for you — no pressure.
What if my house is already in foreclosure?
Facing foreclosure, financial hardship, or just need a fast sale? Get a fair cash offer — any condition, any situation.

Whether you’re facing foreclosure, managing an inherited property, or just need to sell fast — Eliancy Real Estate makes it simple. Paulson Eliancy is both a licensed agent and an active investor, which means more ways to solve your problem. No repairs, no cleaning, no waiting months for a buyer’s financing to fall through.
